title: 建築構造設計
subtitle: Structural Design of Architecture
keywords: Reinforced concrete structures 2.Steel structures 3.Structural design 4.Structural planning
educationalGoal: In this class, knowledge acquired in classes on reinforced concrete structures and steel structures is reorganized, and students learn the concepts and details of structural design flow. Students will carry out the specific structural design of a trial-designed building with a composite structure of reinforced concrete, and in the process cultivate their ability to create structural calculations and drawings.
advice: Class summary 1. Structure design flow and structure planning 2. Loads and external forces 3. Preparation calculations 4. Stress calculations 5. Secondary design 6. Steel member design 7. Steel joint design 8. Design of reinforced concrete members 9. Design of foundation structures 10. Calculation of retained horizontal strength 11. Summary of structural design and structural diagrams
books: textbooks: Structural calculation sheet for KIT A office 2024 (to be revised) reference books: Recommendations for the plastic design of steel structures[AIJ], AIJ standard for allowable stress design of steel structures[AIJ], AIJ standard for structural calculation of reinforced concreate structures revised 2010 {AIJ] reserved books
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of Structural Mechanics for Architecture I and II, Steel Structures, and Reinforced Concrete Structures is required.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the design points and differeces between RC and Steel structures.
Preliminary calculations can be performed on the structural design of simple buildings.
Simple structure stress calculations can be performed.
Steel structure members and joints can be designed.
Students can design reinforced concrete members.
A simple secondary design can be performed.
